description_en: Upgrades or downgrades a Data Warehouse Edition cluster
description_zh: 对数仓版集群进行升降配
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-db-cluster --db-cluster-id am-bp1u8c0mgfg580000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBCluster

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of node groups. Valid values: 1 to 200.
This parameter is required when Mode is set to Reserver (reserved mode)
parameters.help_zh:
节点组数量，取值范围为：1~200。
Mode取值为Reserver（即预留模式）时，本参数必填
parameters.name: db_node_group_count

parameters.help_en:
The storage space of a node. Valid values:
<props="china">
If the node class is C8, valid values are 100 to 1000 GB.</props>
<props="intl">
If the node class is C8, valid values are 100 to 2000 GB.</props>
If the node class is C32, valid values are 100 to 8000 GB.

This parameter is required when Mode is set to Reserver (reserved mode).
The step size is 100 GB for values less than 1000 GB, and 1000 GB for values of 1000 GB or greater
parameters.help_zh:
节点存储空间，取值说明：
<props="china">
规格为C8时，取值范围为：100~1000GB。</props>
<props="intl">
规格为C8时，取值范围为：100~2000GB。</props>
规格为C32时，取值范围为：100~8000GB。

Mode取值为Reserver（即预留模式）时，本参数必填。
1000GB以下步长为100GB，1000GB以上步长为1000GB
parameters.name: db_node_storage

parameters.help_en:
The node specifications. Valid values:
C8
C32
This parameter is required when Mode is set to Reserver (reserved mode)
parameters.help_zh:
节点规格，取值：
C8
C32
Mode取值为Reserver（即预留模式）时，本参数必填
parameters.name: db_node_class

parameters.help_en:
The modification type. Valid values:

Upgrade: Upgrades the cluster.
Downgrade: Downgrades the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
变更类型，取值说明：

Upgrade：升级。
Downgrade：降级
parameters.name: modify_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query available regions
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The compute resource. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190632.html operation to query available compute resources in a specified region.
This parameter is required when Mode is set to Flexible (elastic mode)
parameters.help_zh:
计算资源，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190632.html接口查询指定地域中可用的计算资源。
Mode取值为Flexible（即弹性模式）时，本参数必填
parameters.name: compute_resource

parameters.help_en:
The node specifications for a single node of elastic I/O resources. Valid values:
8Core64GB: If the node specifications for a single node are set to 8Core64GB, the specifications of a group of elastic I/O resources are 24 cores and 192 GB.
12Core96GB: If the node specifications for a single node are set to 12Core96GB, the specifications of a group of elastic I/O resources are 36 cores and 288 GB.

This configuration is supported only when the cluster meets the following conditions:
The cluster must be in elastic mode.
The cluster is in the China (Guangzhou), China (Shenzhen), China (Hangzhou), China (Shanghai), China (Qingdao), China (Beijing), or China (Zhangjiakou) region, and has a compute resource of 16 cores and 64 GB (Cluster Edition) or higher specifications.
The cluster is in other regions and has a compute resource of 32 cores and 128 GB or higher specifications
parameters.help_zh:
弹性资源单节点规格。取值说明：
8Core64GB：单节点规格选择8Core64GB时，一组弹性IO资源的规格为24Core192 GB。
12Core96GB：单节点规格选择12Core96GB时，一组弹性IO资源的规格为36Core288 GB。

仅当集群满足如下条件时，支持该配置。
集群系列需为弹性模式。
华南3（广州）、华南1（深圳）、华东1（杭州）、华东2（上海）、华北1（青岛）、华北2（北京）和华北3（张家口）地域计算资源为16核64 GB（集群版）或以上规格的集群。
其他地域计算资源为32核128 GB或以上规格的集群
parameters.name: elastic_io_resource_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of elastic I/O resources. The maximum number of elastic I/O resources that you can purchase varies based on the specification.
If the elastic I/O resource specification is 8 cores and 64 GB, you can purchase up to 32 groups.
If the elastic I/O resource specification is 12 cores and 96 GB, you can purchase up to 16 groups
parameters.help_zh:
弹性IO资源的数量。不同的弹性IO资源规格，可购买的数量不同。
弹性IO资源规格为8核64 GB，最多可购买32组。
弹性IO资源规格为12核96 GB，最多可购买16组
parameters.name: elastic_io_resource

parameters.help_en:
The edition. Valid values:
Cluster: Cluster Edition in reserved mode.

<props="china">
You can purchase Cluster Edition in reserved mode only in regions in the Chinese mainland and the Singapore region. In the Singapore region, you can purchase Cluster Edition in reserved mode only in pay-as-you-go mode.</props>

MixedStorage: Cluster Edition in elastic mode (new version).
If DBClusterCategory is set to Cluster, Mode must be set to Reserver. If DBClusterCategory is set to MixedStorage, Mode must be set to Flexible. Otherwise, the cluster fails to be created
parameters.help_zh:
系列。取值说明：
Cluster：预留模式集群版。

<props="china">
仅中国内地地域和新加坡地域支持购买预留模式集群版。其中，新加坡地域仅支持在按量付费模式下购买预留模式集群版。</props>

MixedStorage：弹性模式集群版（新版）。
当DBClusterCategory为Cluster时，Mode参数必须填写Reserver；当DBClusterCategory为MixedStorage时，Mode参数必须填写Flexible，否则会导致创建集群失败
parameters.name: db_cluster_category

parameters.help_en:
The mode. Valid values:

Reserver: reserved mode.
Flexible: elastic mode
parameters.help_zh:
模式。取值说明：

Reserver：预留模式。
Flexible：弹性模式
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The performance level (PL) of the cloud disk. Valid values:
PL0
PL1
PL2
PL3
parameters.help_zh:
云盘PL等级。取值可选：
PL0
PL1
PL2
PL3
parameters.name: disk_performance_level
